maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is tuition from students enrolling in trade training programs, a first-time education purchase, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Tuition is largely funded through Title IV federal aid (Pell Grants, federal student loans), plus some GI Bill benefits; this is likely but not certain.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by enrolling more students and adding programs and campuses; acquisitions like Concorde Career Colleges have been occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Students can choose other trade schools or community colleges before enrolling; though mid-program switching costs exist, the offering isn't embedded operationally.

notes: Federal-aid share of revenue is from general knowledge; the website text only mentions Pell and loans as funding options.
